diagnosis.finding: After the shape-invalid involves assertions were set aside diagnostically, valid misses were passage-present but emission-absent across nine predicates. The largest was originates_from with 12 misses across two documents.

one_change: Add and run an opt-in, quote-required, predicate-bounded second extraction pass. It replaced only diagnosed predicate rows and preserved every healthy-predicate row.

scoped_reextract.provider_deviation: The 10-call batch left Unova.md streaming for more than eight minutes; the batch was interrupted after the other nine documents had persisted, then Unova.md completed successfully in a one-document retry.

revert_reason: Coverage did not move toward the gate and both named healthy controls regressed under the measured audit. The optional strategy and its graph artifacts must not become the candidate baseline.
